fusions.name: Fence-Post Butt
fusions.desc: A level shove from planted feet that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 3 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each ally near you (max 32%).

fusions.name: Muster at the Oak
fusions.desc: Stamps the ground under your boughs and deals 26 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Noon Shade
fusions.desc: Spreads your canopy where you stand. For 10 seconds its shade restores 3 health a second to you and any ally within 4 tiles. It grows 10% stronger for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

fusions.name: Slow Chew
fusions.desc: Each time you spend stamina, you regain 2 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds. Your armour rises by 6%.
